description: This file contains functions for serializing SignedCertificateTimestamp objects into dictionaries for logging purposes, including base64 encoding of binary data and generating dictionaries for SCTs and their lists.

methods.name: SetBinaryData
methods.description: Encodes binary data to base64 and inserts it into a dictionary with a specified key.

methods.name: SCTToDictionary
methods.description: Converts a SignedCertificateTimestamp object and its verification status into a dictionary for logging.

methods.name: SCTListToPrintableValues
methods.description: Converts a list of SCTs and their statuses into a list of dictionaries for logging.

methods.name: NetLogSignedCertificateTimestampParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary containing a list of SCTs for net logging.

methods.name: NetLogRawSignedCertificateTimestampParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with raw SCT data from embedded, OCSP, and TLS extension sources for net logging.
